name: @di-framework/cli-plugin-platform
description: di-framework CLI extension that builds, serves, and deploys DI Framework apps as platform WebAssembly components.
author: @di-framework Contributors

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun x tsc -p tsconfig.dist.json && bun build assets/http-adapter.ts --outfile dist/assets/http-adapter.js --packages bundle --external 'wasi:*' --external 'wasmcloud:*' --external 'di-framework:*' --external '@di-framework/actors' --external '@di-framework/actors/portable' --external '@di-framework/repo' --external '@di-framework/repo/portable' --external '@di-framework/queues' --external '@di-framework/queues/portable' --external 'virtual:di-framework-application' --external 'virtual:di-framework-wasmcloud-guests' --external 'virtual:di-framework-wasmcloud-actors' --external 'virtual:di-framework-wasmcloud-cron' --external 'virtual:di-framework-wasmcloud-queues' --external 'virtual:di-framework-wasmcloud-runtime' && bun build assets/queue-adapter.ts --outfile dist/assets/queue-adapter.js --packages bundle --external 'wasi:*' --external 'wasmcloud:*' --external 'di-framework:*' --external '@di-framework/actors' --external '@di-framework/actors/portable' --external 'virtual:di-framework-application' --external 'virtual:di-framework-wasmcloud-guests' --external 'virtual:di-framework-wasmcloud-actors' && cp -R assets/wit dist/assets/wit && cp -R assets/platform dist/assets/platform && bun ../../scripts/copy-sqlite-asset.ts && bun ../../scripts/fix-esm-imports.ts dist && bun build console-ui/src/main.tsx --outdir dist/console-ui --target browser --minify --entry-naming 'app.[ext]' --asset-naming '[name].[ext]' --public-path /assets/ && cp console-ui/index.html dist/console-ui/index.html
